what: To the right of the ‹See more› text sits a hexagon plate 78 wide by 68 tall with a thin arrow above it. On hover only the hexagon plate rotates 45° over .175s ease-in-out so the corner positions swap (the arrow stays). On release it returns over the same time — a small touch that suits the calm paper-textured screen

options.--fx-hex: Panel color, default var(--kf-raised) (becomes a gray surface on a white card)
options.--fx-gap: Right margin between post and panel, default 90px

use: Your see more link here · On the white card: style="--fx-hex: var(--kf-line)"
note: Uses CSS only — this part uses ::before (arrow) and ::after (hex plate)

from.where: shared.css .cmn-btn a (original .cmn-btn a::after clip-path hexagon 78×68, transition all .175s ease-in-out, :hover rotate(45deg) · inside white cards the fill is #e8e8e8)
